step.command: OVERLAY_DIR=${BPFREJIT_IMAGE_WORKSPACE}/runner/config/passes/map_inline/overlays/katran; CH=; RE=; SI=; VIP=; for f in ${MAP_VALUES}/map-*.show.json; do n=$(jq -r .name "$f"); i=$(jq -r .id "$f"); case ",${MAP_IDS}," in *,$i,*) ;; *) continue ;; esac; case "$n" in vip_map) VIP=$i ;; ch_rings|reals|server_id_map) d=${MAP_VALUES}/map-$i.dump.json; if jq -e '.skipped == true' "$d" >/dev/null; then case "$n" in ch_rings) CH=$i ;; reals) RE=$i ;; server_id_map) SI=$i ;; esac; fi ;; esac; done; jq -n --arg c "$CH" --arg r "$RE" --arg s "$SI" --slurpfile co "$OVERLAY_DIR/ch_rings.json" --slurpfile ro "$OVERLAY_DIR/reals.json" --slurpfile so "$OVERLAY_DIR/server_id_map.json" '($c | if . == "" then {} else {(.): $co[0]} end) + ($r | if . == "" then {} else {(.): $ro[0]} end) + ($s | if . == "" then {} else {(.): $so[0]} end)' > ${MAP_VALUES}/overlays.json; VIP_TCP=0a6401010000000000000000000000001f900600; VIP_UDP=0a6401010000000000000000000000001f901100; VIP_DUMP=${MAP_VALUES}/map-$VIP.dump.json; if jq -e --arg key "$VIP_TCP" 'any(.[]?; ((.key // []) | map(sub("^0x"; "") | ascii_downcase) | join("")) == $key)' "$VIP_DUMP" >/dev/null; then VIP_KEY=$VIP_TCP; elif jq -e --arg key "$VIP_UDP" 'any(.[]?; ((.key // []) | map(sub("^0x"; "") | ascii_downcase) | join("")) == $key)' "$VIP_DUMP" >/dev/null; then VIP_KEY=$VIP_UDP; else echo "katran map_inline: neither TCP nor UDP benchmark VIP key is present in $VIP_DUMP" >&2; exit 1; fi; bpfopt --pass map_inline --input ${INPUT} --output ${OUTPUT} --report ${REPORT} --prog-type ${PROG_TYPE} -- --map-values ${MAP_VALUES} --map-ids ${MAP_IDS} --stability phase-stable --include-map=ctl_array --include-map=vip_map --include-map=ch_rings --include-map=decap_dst --include-map=reals --include-map=server_id_map --inline-hint=decap_dst:c0000202000000000000000000000000 --inline-hint=vip_map:$VIP_KEY --inline-hint=reals:01000000 --assume-hint-key # lpm_src_v4/v6 hints commented: katran is built without # -DLPM_SRC_LOOKUP, so these maps are guarded out of the program # by `#ifdef LPM_SRC_LOOKUP` in balancer_maps.h. bpfopt fail-fasts # on hint anchor not in metadata (correct: catches typos and # mis-applied hints early). Uncomment if a future build turns on # source-IP routing. # --inline-hint=lpm_src_v4:00000000 # --inline-hint=lpm_src_v6:00000000 # lru_mapping/global_lru_maps outer-only hints commented: katran # benchmark uses F_LRU_BYPASS + no `-forwarding_cores`, so the outer # ARRAY_OF_MAPS stays empty (every slot ENOENT). #265 root-caused this: # `attachLrus()` iterates empty forwardingCores_  zero update_elem. # bpfopt fail-fasts when hinted outer key has no live inner map # (correct: hint claims something kernel snapshot disproves). # Uncomment only if benchmark configures forwarding cores OR an # alternative test deploys populated map-in-map. # --inline-hint=lru_mapping:00000000 # --inline-hint=global_lru_maps:00000000
step.name: map_inline
